title: Home Game (TV series)
executive_producers: Ryan DuffyAustin RezaAndrew FriedDane LillegardJordan WynnMatti LeshemLou Arbetter
premise_summary: Home Game is a sports documentary television series. The series profiles unique and dangerous traditional sports from around the world, as well as the communities and cultures where they thrive. The series premiered on Netflix on 26 June 2020 and is narrated by Mark Strong.
